##### Project general facts

Address Grand Downtown redefines opulent living, merging the renowned hospitality of the Address brand with exquisite architectural design. The residence offers a refined collection of grand suites, thoughtfully designed with open layouts, expansive ceilings, and retractable glass walls that blend indoor and outdoor living seamlessly. Every home is a personalised sanctuary, crafted to reflect the tastes and lifestyle of its residents while framing truly breathtaking views.

Residents of Address Grand Downtown enjoy an extraordinary collection of amenities curated for ultimate luxury and exclusivity. The development features a stunning infinity pool, an adult-only rooftop pool, and a dedicated family club complete with a sun deck and tanning ledge, alongside a state-of-the-art fitness center and a professional-grade yoga studio. Private spa facilities, a sophisticated private lounge, concierge services, and a dedicated chauffeur's suite complete an experience designed to cater to every need.

The interiors embody a commitment to exceptional craftsmanship and elevated materiality, blending sophistication with quiet luxury. Pristine marble flooring flows through the living areas, kitchens, and bathrooms, while decorative walls feature crafted wallpapers and accent marble elements paired with built-in wood veneer cabinetry. Functional kitchens are equipped with quartz countertops and premium built-in appliances, and the lavish, light-filled bathrooms showcase top-tier sanitaryware and custom joinery throughout.

##### Location description and benefits

As the name suggests, Downtown Dubai is the centre of Dubai, constantly evolving at a fast pace. Home to many landmarks and world-famous attractions, including Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Mall and Dancing Fountains, the area is a hub of activities. The prime location keeps Downtown busy throughout the year. Constantly attracting tourists, there’re always some new things to do in Downtown Dubai. 

The area is best known for offering a luxurious lifestyle. It used to be a vertical community, but many villas have also been added to the real estate market. As per Bayut’s 2020 Rental Market Report, it is the second most popular area offering luxury apartments for rent after Dubai Marina. Downtown is well connected to other key commercial and residential areas in the city. 

Strategically located along Sheikh Zayed Road, E11, across Al Wasl and bordering Business Bay, it is a pretty active and bustling neighbourhood. Downtown is one of Dubai’s best areas for non-drivers and frequent travellers. Many amenities, including upscale hotels, chic leisure points and massive shopping centres, make Downtown Dubai a sought-after address and “the centre of now”.
